diagnostics.message: `aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook` uses `auto_deploy = true` and therefore creates a deployment when the stage is created, capturing only the routes/integrations that already exist. The stage references only `aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook`, tags, and access-log settings — nothing orders it after `aws_apigatewayv2_route.webhook` (which in turn depends on `aws_apigatewayv2_integration.webhook`). On a fresh apply, Terraform may create the stage before the route exists, so the initial deployment omits the `POST /webhook` route and the live endpoint 404s until a subsequent deploy. It should depend on the route (which transitively orders the integration) via `depends_on`.
